observation: Round 1 (enhancing.curvature_threshold 0.0004; detecting binary 115, oblique Hough 35/65, horizontal 45, pattern_tolerance 12) moved the proxy only 0.6829 -> 0.6872 and correspondence_f1@15 0.453 -> 0.461; ring_count_error stayed 0, sam_fill_rate unchanged 0.751, depth NaN 0.194 -> 0.195 (family-normal). Stages 1-3 remain healthy (residual 2.1 cm, orient_axis_corr 0.84, retention 0.76), and the 10 vertical Hough lines at ~360 px pitch still match 10 rings, so the ring frame is not the problem. The prompt-centre plot after round 1 still shows 4 'assume' fallbacks (rings at x=180, 540, 900 and 3420 px) placed at y=1120/1550 px, 3 'midpoint' centres and only 3 single-slope centres; the fallback ratio is effectively unchanged at 0.4. In detected_lines.png the oblique red/green pairs that define K blocks appear only in the central rings (x 1100-3250); in the three leftmost rings and the rightmost ring the binarised outlier map contains no oblique K-joint trace at all, only faint, dotted horizontal joint traces 80-250 px long with pixel gaps well above the horizontal maxLineGap of 10 px, so the horizontal HoughLinesP (threshold 45, minLineLength 105, maxLineGap 10) yields at most one blue segment per ring there and the K/AB distance-pattern check fails, forcing 'assume'. The assumed y=1120/1550 positions sit inside the crown band where the two longitudinal service pipes produce full-width NaN stripes (y ~1240 and ~1450 px), so the assumed K templates are cropped over voids; in the SC overlay every label boundary in these four rings is red (unsupported) while the central rings with real or midpoint prompts show mostly green boundaries and cyan-explained joint lines. Segmentation geometry is consistent where prompts are real (K-pair spacing ~245 px = 1227 mm at 5 mm/px, ring pitch 360 px = 1800 mm), so SAM knobs are not the limiting factor.
rule: d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered) -> f_missing_lines, now localised to the edge rings; d8 (m_spacing_regularity poor vs K/AB pattern) -> f_pattern_mismatch on the four 'assume' rings because too few horizontal joint lines survive to form the K/AB pattern; inter-stage chain stage_4.f_pattern_mismatch -> stage_5.f_crop_offset explains the red boundaries concentrated in those rings. Remediation r_relax_hough applied to the HORIZONTAL branch this time (raise maxLineGap toward bridging the dotted traces, lower threshold), with the r_relax_hough precondition satisfied: NaN and retention are family-normal (no f_depth_holes / f_over_gate), and d6 f_joint_oversmoothed cannot be addressed further because depth_threshold_low/high are outside the bounded interface. Experiences section 5: real-vs-fallback discrimination is what matters for complex t4&5 rings; section 7 tuning order: stages 1-3 validated in round 1, so round 2 stays on detection and defers SAM geometry.
failure_mode: f_pattern_mismatch (stage_4_detection) on the four edge rings, driven by f_missing_lines in the horizontal fallback path (dotted joint traces not bridged); downstream f_crop_offset in stage 5 places K templates over the crown service-pipe voids.
rationale: Round 1 confirmed that relaxing the oblique branch alone cannot recover rings whose K joints leave no oblique trace in the outlier map; those rings must be recovered through the horizontal K/AB distance pattern instead. Overlays are applied to the anchor parameters, so the round-1 detection settings are restated and extended: (1) detecting.maxLineGap_horizontal 10 -> 28 so the dotted horizontal joint traces (gaps of roughly 15-25 px between enhanced outlier pixels) are bridged into segments longer than the 105 px minLineLength; (2) detecting.hough_threshold_horizontal 45 -> 32 so sparser dotted traces reach the accumulator threshold once bridged, while staying above the bound floor to avoid bolt-hole rows (bolt marks are ~40-60 px apart and would still exceed the gap) being read as lines; (3) detecting.binary_threshold 115 -> 110 so slightly fainter joint pixels in the low-density left rings survive binarisation and feed both Hough branches; (4) detecting.pattern_tolerance 12 -> 15 px so bridged lines whose fitted y is a few pixels off the ideal K (245 px) / AB (745 px) spacing are still accepted by check_distance_pattern instead of dropping to 'assume'; (5) oblique branch kept at round-1 values (threshold 35, maxLineGap 65) because it already yields the real K pairs in the central rings and further relaxation only added tiny spurious red stubs; (6) enhancing.curvature_threshold kept at 0.0004 for continuity so the between-round delta is attributable to the horizontal-branch change; (7) hough_threshold_vertical untouched (10 verticals = 10 rings); (8) denoising and sam untouched (geometry knobs are load-bearing for transfer, and measured K/ring pitch match the priors); unfolding omitted because stage1_unlocked is false. Expected GT-free signal: det_fallback_ratio down from 0.4 (fewer 'assume' types, more 'midpoint'/pattern-derived centres), det_n_points still 10, correspondence_f1@15 up from 0.46 as the edge-ring label boundaries move onto the horizontal joints, sam_segment_size_cv down from 1.09, sam_fill_rate >= 0.75, ring_count_error 0, NaN ratio unchanged; proxy expected to move from 0.687 toward the 0.70 accept threshold. Failure signature to watch: if det_n_points rises above 10 or spurious blue lines appear on bolt-hole rows, the horizontal threshold went too low and round 3 should raise it back toward 40 while keeping maxLineGap_horizontal.
